---
title: Section references
extensions:
  mcanouil:
    type: memo
    kind: note
    memo:
      to: Data team
      from: M. Canouil
      date: 11 Nov 2026
format:
  mcanouil-typst:
    keep-typ: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        description: In a memo, whose headings have no number, a reference to a section links to the heading with the supplement and the heading text.
        check: bash _checks/xref.sh section 'Section Introduction'
        warnings: exhaustive
    mcanouil-typst:
      noErrors: true
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        - ['See #ref\(<sec-intro>, supplement: \[']
---
